case_number: 2024 INSC 178; I.A. NO.20650 OF 2023 IN WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) NO.202 OF 1995
summary: Illegality of tiger safaris vs zoos; Pakhrau tiger safari invalidated; forest destruction via construction/tree felling; public trust doctrine enforced; ecological restitution mandated; Yellowstone wolf reintroduction referenced as ecosystem model; NTCA guidelines binding; violations of WLP Act, FC Act confirmed; demolition of illegal structures ordered; restoration protocols prescribed.
final_judgment: Illegal constructions demolished; ecological restoration directed; NTCA guidelines compliance mandated; impugned inaction set aside.
